headline: Menzies knocks out Bunting as Price, Searle and Cross advance
standfirst: Monday's final group games sent Stephen Bunting and Tommy Morris home, while Rob Cross, Gerwyn Price and Ryan Searle secured last-16 places.
body: Stephen Bunting was eliminated from the Grand Slam of Darts on Monday night, beaten 5-2 by Cameron Menzies in a Group D decider at Aldersley Leisure Village. Menzies finished the match with a run of three consecutive big checkouts.

According to Darts World, Menzies took out 144, then 102, and closed the match with a 135 finish on the bullseye. He now meets Kevin Doets in the last 16. Doets beat Tommy Morris 5-1 in Group C, ending a debut tournament in which Morris had beaten Josh Rock on Saturday. Doets closed the game with a 121 checkout.

Gerwyn Price, bidding for a fourth Grand Slam title, won Group E with a 5-2 victory over Sebastian Bialecki. Ryan Searle beat Andrew Gilding 5-1 in a scrappy clash to clinch his group, and he will face Price in round two.
Rob Cross topped Group G by beating Anton Ostlund 5-1. Cross had averaged 114.32 in his win over Clayton on Sunday.
In Group H, Niko Springer beat Wessel Nijman 5-3 with a 105.23 average, setting up a last-16 tie against Cross.
Elsewhere, Jermaine Wattimena won Group B 5-4 against Alan Soutar, and Niels Zonneveld beat Luke Littler by the same score in Group A.
Groups I to P play their final group matches on Tuesday, with Luke Humphries facing Joe Cullen and Michael van Gerwen playing Jeffrey de Graaf.
